integrity.computation: Two deterministic C++17 enumerations with different vertex indexing reproduce all face counts and mod-two boundary ranks.
integrity.dependencies: C++17 standard library only; no external packages or downloaded datasets.

scientific_limitations: The claim determines homology only over \(\mathbb F_2\) for the single parameter pair \((n,k)=(6,4)\).
It does not determine integral torsion, cup products, the fundamental group, or the homotopy type.
Independent external validation has not been performed.
title: Mod-two homology of the scale-four Vietoris–Rips complex of the six-by-six torus grid
